member.name: T:JordiAragonZaragoza.Cinema.Reservation.Mcp.Gateway.Common.Infrastructure.AuthorizationDelegatingHandler
member.summary: Forwards the caller's identity and execution context to the Reservation APIs. Single place to replace the token pass-through by a token exchange (Keycloak token exchange, Entra On-Behalf-Of) if the MCP gateway ever needs its own audience.
